_comment: v1.40.0:目标计算摘要、按月结余达成时间与独立估算设置。只读取beta已有退休计划,不固定本地目标编号;默认金额隐私,不保存配置或调用模型。

pc.name: goal-summary
pc.eval: var c=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-goal-strip-card]')).find(e=>e.querySelector('[data-estimate-dashboard]'));if(!c)throw new Error('需要一个支持时间估算的目标');c.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});c.querySelector('[data-kpi-info]').click();

pc.name: goal-cashflow-time
pc.eval: var a=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="/goals/"]')).find(a=>a.textContent.includes('退休生活账'));if(!a)throw new Error('需要一个已保存的退休计划');a.href+='/retirement#goal-estimate-result';a.click();

pc.name: goal-estimate-settings
pc.eval: var a=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="/goals/"]')).find(a=>a.textContent.includes('退休生活账'));if(!a)throw new Error('需要一个已保存的退休计划');a.href+='/retirement?tab=plan#goal-estimate-settings';a.click();
pc.afterEval: var e=document.querySelector('#goal-estimate-settings');if(!e)throw new Error('缺少时间估算设置');window.scrollTo({top:Math.max(0,e.getBoundingClientRect().top+scrollY-96),behavior:'instant'});

mobile.name: goal-summary
mobile.eval: var c=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-goal-strip-card]')).find(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width>0&&e.querySelector('[data-estimate-dashboard]'));if(!c)throw new Error('需要一个支持时间估算的目标');c.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});c.querySelector('[data-kpi-info]').click();
